description: 🚀 Join Our NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 Team! We are working on "Abandoned but not Forgotten," exploring NASA's historical space equipment on the Moon and Mars. We are looking for three enthusiastic teammates interested in space exploration, coding, web development, research, or UI/UX design. Beginners are welcome! Let's collaborate, learn, and create something amazing together! 🌍
summary: M&M FAMILY – Moon & Mars is an interactive educational website developed by Team ASTRA4 to address NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026's theme, "Abandoned but Not Forgotten." We developed a digital exploration archive that brings together the stories of NASA's lost, unsuccessful, and abandoned Moon and Mars missions. The website features separate Moon and Mars exploration sections, individual spacecraft pages, historical timelines, animated stories for children, narrated documentaries for adults, detailed research reports, original NASA/JPL archival references, and interactive quizzes. By transforming scattered technical information and mission records into an engaging storytelling experience, our project directly addresses the challenge of making forgotten space mission stories accessible and understandable, especially for school-age students and space enthusiasts. It is important because unsuccessful missions are also valuable parts of space exploration history. Their failures provide important scientific and engineering lessons that can help improve future missions. Through this platform, we aim to preserve these stories, increase awareness of past space exploration efforts, encourage curiosity about science and technology, and inspire younger generations to explore the mysteries of space. Our central message is that even when a mission fails, the knowledge it leaves behind should never be forgotten.
details:
M&M FAMILY – Moon & Mars is an interactive educational website developed by Team ASTRA4 for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, based on the challenge “Abandoned but Not Forgotten.” The project aims to preserve and share the stories of NASA's lost, unsuccessful, and abandoned Moon and Mars missions in an engaging and educational way. It brings together mission histories, spacecraft details, research reports, NASA/JPL archival documents, and photographs in a single platform. Users can explore different Moon and Mars missions through animated storytelling for children, narrated documentaries for adults, detailed text reports, historical timelines, and interactive quizzes. The website is developed using React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with browser-based SpeechSynthesis for narration and the Web Audio API for sound effects. We used Google Gemini as an AI assistant for code structure, summaries, and quiz content, while referring to authentic NASA/JPL resources for mission information. The creativity of our project lies in transforming complex technical information into an interactive storytelling experience that makes space science accessible and interesting for different age groups. While developing the project, we considered factors such as educational value, accessibility, user experience, authenticity of information, engagement, and preservation of mission history. The project benefits students, educators, and space enthusiasts by making scientific information easier to understand, encouraging curiosity about space exploration, and highlighting the valuable lessons learned from unsuccessful missions. Our intended impact is to inspire future generations, increase awareness of forgotten space missions, and demonstrate that even missions that fail can contribute to scientific progress and future exploration.

"Missions may fail, spacecraft may be lost, but the knowledge they leave behind helps humanity explore further."
